acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_reagent.evidence: modifications: monohydroxylated residue; acetylated residue; deamidated residue; iodoacetamide derivatized residue

cleavage_agent.evidence: subjected to destaining, reducing/alkylation, and in-gel trypsin digestion

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS/MS data acquisitions were operated at a 120,000 resolution (m/z 200) with a scan range of 400-1600 m/z and HCD fragmentation.

ionization_type.evidence: The extracted peptides were applied for LC-MS/MS analysis using a Thermo Orbitrap Fusion Lumos operated with an in-line Thermo nLC 1200 and an EASY-Spray ion source.

labeling.evidence: inferred: All data was processed using Proteome Discoverer v2.4 (Thermo Scientific) with a SEQUEST HT search against the Uniprot KB/Swiss-Prot Human Proteome (02/2021) and common contaminants (theGPM.org) using a 5ppm precursor mass tolerance and a 0.5 Da fragment tolerance.
